vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: repomix
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is a legitimate wrapper for the 'repomix' utility, designed to pack codebases into AI-friendly formats for analysis. It uses standard 'npx' commands to execute the official package and includes helpful instructions for the AI agent to perform code exploration and token counting without any signs of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose, required binaries, and runtime instructions are coherent (it installs/runs an npm repomix CLI to pack/analyze repos), but pay attention to supply‑chain and data‑leakage risks from running npx@latest and writing outputs to /tmp.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (pack and analyze repos) aligns with requirements and instructions: it only needs npx and installs/uses the repomix npm package to produce analysis files. No unrelated environment variables, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run npx repomix (remote and local repo packing), inspect output files in /tmp, and grep the produced output. This stays within the stated purpose, but the instructions assume the repomix CLI performs safe filtering (e.g., excluding .env) — that is a claim in the doc, not an enforceable guarantee. Also, running the CLI will cause network activity (fetching npm package and remote repos) and will write potentially sensitive aggregated code to /tmp, which can be accessible to other users on multi-user systems.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install is a standard npm package (repomix) which will create a 'repomix' binary. Installing/running via npx repomix@latest executes code fetched from the npm registry at runtime — expected for this tool but a supply-chain risk. No downloads from obscure URLs or archive extracts are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables or external credentials, which is proportionate to a local/remote repository packing tool. There are no demands for unrelated secrets or config paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated persistence. It is user-invocable and allowed to run autonomously (platform default), which is appropriate for this sort of CLI integration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it runs an npm CLI to pack/analyze repositories. Before installing/using it: (1) be aware that npx repomix@latest will fetch and execute code from the npm registry — prefer pinning a specific verified version or installing from a checked source if you care about supply‑chain safety; (2) confirm the repomix project on its GitHub homepage and review its source or recent releases if possible; (3) do not run it against sensitive code on shared systems without isolation — outputs written to /tmp may be world-readable on some systems and the tool may upload or phone home (the SKILL.md does not show network destinations beyond fetching repos/npm); (4) do not assume claimed sensitive-file filtering is perfect — manually verify outputs before sharing them with third parties or LLMs; (5) if you need stronger guarantees, run repomix inside a container or sandbox and/or clone repos locally and scan those copies.
